input.command:
cd /home/noah/propscan && PYTHONPATH=/home/noah/propscan/src python3 -c "
from propscan.core import PropScan
scanner = PropScan()

# Get a few packages from pacman
pacman_manager = None
for manager in scanner.managers:
    if manager.name == 'Pacman' and manager.is_available():
        pacman_manager = manager
        break

if pacman_manager:
    packages = pacman_manager.get_installed_packages()[:5]  # Just first 5
    print('Sample packages with licenses:')
    for pkg in packages:
        is_prop = scanner.detector.is_proprietary(pkg)
        print(f'  {pkg[\"name\"]}: {pkg[\"licenses\"]} -> {\"PROPRIETARY\" if is_prop else \"FOSS\"}')
else:
    print('Pacman not available')
"
